item.title: MISTRESS KANAN IS DEVILISHLY EASY Manga Takes Short Break, Returns Later This Month
item.description: Nonco's Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy manga is taking a short pause in Weekly Shōnen Magazine's 10th issue, resuming later this month. The anime adaptation premieres in a few months.

item.title: IS IT WRONG TO TRY TO PICK UP GIRLS IN A DUNGEON? Anime Season 6 Has Been Announced
item.description: DanMachi Season 6 has been officially announced at the series' 10th anniversary event on February 7th, 2026. There is no release date, however, fans got their first look in a new teaser trailer.

item.title: RENT-A-GIRLFRIEND Anime Season 5 Teaser Video Dropped And Theme Songs Revealed
item.description: Rent-A-Girlfriend's Season 5 teaser trailer has dropped, along with news of Sora Amamiya's "Non Scenario Etude" opening and NAKIGOTO's "204-gōshitsu" ending. The 5th season arrives later this year.

item.title: MONSTER EATER Light Anime Adaptation Reveals Second Teaser And Main Cast
item.description: Monster Eater (also known as Mamonogurai no Bōkensha) light anime adaptation reveals their second teaser video, main cast members, music and sound staff.

item.title: MADE IN ABYSS Teases First Film In New Trilogy With New Video And Fall 2026 Premiere
item.description: The latest teaser for Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi reveals key staff for the film, confirms a fall 2026 release for the first of three films, and brings back the core cast and crew.

item.title: THE LAID-OFF CHEAT-GRANTING MAGE ENJOYS A NEW LIFE Novels Is Receiving An Anime Adaptation
item.description: Shochiku announces a TV anime adaptation of The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys A New Life light novels. The announcement came with a new teaser visual revealed.

item.title: GKIDS Brings Shoji Kawamori's LABYRINTH Anime Film To North American Theaters In May
item.description: GKIDS has acquired North American rights to the original anime film Labyrinth, screening it in theaters during May this year, the film will have English subtitles and an English dub available for watchers.

item.title: DOROHEDORO Season 2 Global Premiere Date, Updated Staff And Key Visual Revealed
item.description: The official Dorohedoro anime site has dropped a fresh key visual for Season 2 along with updated staff credits and a confirmed global premiere date for this spring.

item.title: ICHIJOMA MANKITSU GURASHI! Anime Unveils Four New Characters And A Fresh Teaser Trailer
item.description: The TV anime adaptation of Kumako Hisama's Ichijōma Mankitsu Gurashi! has revealed four additional characters and a new teaser trailer, building anticipation for its April 2026 debut.

item.title: TOKYO GHOUL Creator Sui Ishida Gives A Very Humble Response To Anime Criticism On Social Media
item.description: A viral X post revives Sui Ishida's old 2021 livestream comments about the Tokyo Ghoul anime adaptation, where he expressed gratitude despite fan frustrations over manga deviations
